    1  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/FoldLedgerApp.kt */
    2  package com.foldledger
    3  import android.app.Application
    4  import android.content.Context
    5  import com.foldledger.data.db.AppDatabase
    6  import com.foldledger.data.prefs.AppPreferences
    7  import com.foldledger.data.repo.LedgerRepository
    8  object ServiceLocator {
    9      @Volatile
   10      private var initialized = false
   11      lateinit var repository: LedgerRepository
   12          private set
   13      lateinit var preferences: AppPreferences
   14          private set
   15      lateinit var appContext: Context
   16          private set
   17      val db: AppDatabase get() = AppDatabase.get(appContext)
   18      fun init(context: Context) {
   19          if (initialized) return
   20          synchronized(this) {
   21              if (initialized) return
   22              appContext = context.applicationContext
   23              repository = LedgerRepository(AppDatabase.get(appContext))
   24              preferences = AppPreferences(appContext)
   25              initialized = true
   26          }
   27      }
   28  }
   29  class FoldLedgerApp : Application() {
   30      override fun onCreate() {
   31          super.onCreate()
   32          ServiceLocator.init(this)
   33      }
   34  }

   55  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/auto/AutoBookkeepingListener.kt */
   56  package com.foldledger.auto
   57  import android.app.Notification
   58  import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService
   59  import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification
   60  import com.foldledger.ServiceLocator
   61  import com.foldledger.util.PaymentParser
   62  import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
   63  import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
   64  import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
   65  import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
   66  import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
   67  import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
   68  class AutoBookkeepingListener : NotificationListenerService() {
   69      private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
   70      override fun onListenerConnected() {
   71          super.onListenerConnected()
   72          ServiceLocator.init(applicationContext)
   73      }
   74      override fun onNotificationPosted(sbn: StatusBarNotification?) {
   75          sbn ?: return
   76          if (sbn.isOngoing) return
   77          val notification = sbn.notification ?: return
   78          val extras = notification.extras ?: return
   79          val title = extras.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE)?.toString() ?: ""
   80          val text = (
   81              extras.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_BIG_TEXT)
   82                  ?: extras.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TEXT)
   83              )?.toString() ?: ""
   84          if (title.isBlank() && text.isBlank()) return
   85          val parsed = PaymentParser.parseNotification(
   86              pkg = sbn.packageName ?: "",
   87              title = title,
   88              text = text,
   89              postTime = sbn.postTime
   90          ) ?: return
   91          scope.launch {
   92              runCatching {
   93                  val enabled = ServiceLocator.preferences.settings.first().autoBookkeepingEnabled
   94                  if (!enabled) return@launch
   95                  ServiceLocator.repository.recordAutoPayment(parsed)
   96              }
   97          }
   98      }
   99      override fun onDestroy() {
  100          super.onDestroy()

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 3 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  101          scope.cancel()
  102      }
  103  }

  105  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/auto/SmsReceiver.kt */
  106  package com.foldledger.auto
  107  import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
  108  import android.content.Context
  109  import android.content.Intent
  110  import android.provider.Telephony
  111  import com.foldledger.ServiceLocator
  112  import com.foldledger.util.PaymentParser
  113  import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
  114  import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
  115  import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
  116  import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
  117  import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
  118  class SmsReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
  119      override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
  120          if (intent.action != Telephony.Sms.Intents.SMS_RECEIVED_ACTION) return
  121          ServiceLocator.init(context.applicationContext)
  122          val messages = Telephony.Sms.Intents.getMessagesFromIntent(intent) ?: return
  123          val body = messages.joinToString("") { it.messageBody ?: "" }
  124          if (body.isBlank()) return
  125          val parsed = PaymentParser.parseSms(body) ?: return
  126          val pending = goAsync()
  127          CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO).launch {
  128              try {
  129                  val enabled = ServiceLocator.preferences.settings.first().autoBookkeepingEnabled
  130                  if (enabled) {
  131                      ServiceLocator.repository.recordAutoPayment(
  132                          parsed.copy(atMillis = System.currentTimeMillis())
  133                      )
  134                  }
  135              } finally {
  136                  pending.finish()
  137              }
  138          }
  139      }
  140  }

  142  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/core/DripCore.kt */
  143  package com.foldledger.core
  144  import com.foldledger.util.Money
  145  object DripCore {
  146      val nativeAvailable: Boolean = runCatching {
  147          System.loadLibrary("drip_core")
  148          true
  149      }.getOrDefault(false)
  150      fun formatCents(cents: Long, symbol: Boolean): String =

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 4 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  151          if (nativeAvailable) runCatching { nativeFormatCents(cents, symbol) }.getOrDefault(Money.format(cents, symbol))
  152          else Money.format(cents, symbol)
  153      fun toPlain(cents: Long): String =
  154          if (nativeAvailable) runCatching { nativeToPlain(cents) }.getOrDefault(Money.centsToPlain(cents))
  155          else Money.centsToPlain(cents)
  156      fun parseToCents(input: String): Long? {
  157          if (nativeAvailable) {
  158              val v = runCatching { nativeParseToCents(input) }.getOrDefault(PARSE_INVALID)
  159              return if (v == PARSE_INVALID) null else v
  160          }
  161          return Money.parseToCents(input)
  162      }
  163      fun matchesQuery(name: String, note: String, amountCents: Long, query: String): Boolean =
  164          if (nativeAvailable) runCatching { nativeMatchesQuery(name, note, amountCents, query) }
  165              .getOrDefault(kotlinMatchesQuery(name, note, amountCents, query))
  166          else kotlinMatchesQuery(name, note, amountCents, query)
  167      fun validateBackup(bytes: ByteArray): Boolean =
  168          if (nativeAvailable) runCatching { nativeValidateBackup(bytes) }
  169              .getOrDefault(kotlinValidateBackup(bytes))
  170          else kotlinValidateBackup(bytes)
  171      fun fnv1a(bytes: ByteArray): Int =
  172          if (nativeAvailable) runCatching { nativeFnv1a(bytes) }.getOrDefault(kotlinFnv1a(bytes))
  173          else kotlinFnv1a(bytes)
  174      private external fun nativeFormatCents(cents: Long, symbol: Boolean): String
  175      private external fun nativeToPlain(cents: Long): String
  176      private external fun nativeParseToCents(input: String): Long
  177      private external fun nativeMatchesQuery(name: String, note: String, amountCents: Long, query: String): Boolean
  178      private external fun nativeValidateBackup(data: ByteArray): Boolean
  179      private external fun nativeFnv1a(data: ByteArray): Int
  180      private const val PARSE_INVALID = Long.MIN_VALUE
  181      private fun kotlinMatchesQuery(
  182          name: String,
  183          note: String,
  184          amountCents: Long,
  185          query: String
  186      ): Boolean {
  187          val q = query.trim()
  188          if (q.isEmpty()) return true
  189          val nameL = name.lowercase()
  190          val noteL = note.lowercase()
  191          val abs = kotlin.math.abs(amountCents)
  192          val plain = Money.centsToPlain(abs)
  193          val grouped = Money.format(abs, symbol = false)
  194          return q.split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.all { token ->
  195              val t = token.lowercase()
  196              var hit = nameL.contains(t) || noteL.contains(t)
  197              if (!hit && isNumericToken(t)) {
  198                  hit = plain.contains(t) || grouped.contains(t)
  199              }
  200              hit

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 5 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  201          }
  202      }
  203      private fun isNumericToken(t: String): Boolean =
  204          t.isNotEmpty() && t.all { it.isDigit() || it == '.' || it == ',' }
  205      private fun kotlinValidateBackup(bytes: ByteArray): Boolean {
  206          val s = String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
  207          val isDrip = s.contains("\"format\":\"foldledger.backup\"")
  208          val version = jsonInt(s, "version") ?: 0
  209          return isDrip && version in 1..2 && s.contains("\"ledgers\":") && s.contains("\"transactions\":")
  210      }
  211      private fun kotlinFnv1a(bytes: ByteArray): Int {
  212          var h = -0x7ee3623b // 0x811c9dc5 as signed Int
  213          for (b in bytes) {
  214              h = h xor (b.toInt() and 0xFF)
  215              h = h * 0x01000193
  216          }
  217          return h
  218      }
  219      private fun jsonInt(text: String, key: String): Int? {
  220          val pat = "\"$key\":"
  221          val idx = text.indexOf(pat)
  222          if (idx < 0) return null
  223          val rest = text.substring(idx + pat.length)
  224          val num = rest.takeWhile { it.isDigit() || it == '-' }
  225          return num.toIntOrNull()
  226      }
  227  }

  601              p("🔔", "通知 提醒"),
  602              p("🌐", "网络 线上")

  604      )
  605      val all: List<PresetIcon> by lazy {
  606          groups.flatMap { it.icons }
  607              .groupBy { it.emoji }
  608              .map { (emoji, list) -> PresetIcon(emoji, list.joinToString(" ") { it.keywords }) }
  609      }
  610      fun search(query: String): List<PresetIcon>? {
  611          val q = query.trim()
  612          if (q.isEmpty()) return null
  613          return all.filter { it.keywords.contains(q, ignoreCase = true) || it.emoji == q }
  614      }
  615  }

  617  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/data/RecurringSchedule.kt */
  618  package com.foldledger.data
  619  import com.foldledger.data.db.RecurringInterval
  620  import java.time.Instant
  621  import java.time.ZoneId
  622  object RecurringSchedule {
  623      fun advance(from: Long, kind: Int, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): Long {
  624          val dt = Instant.ofEpochMilli(from).atZone(zone).toLocalDateTime()
  625          val next = when (kind) {
  626              RecurringInterval.WEEKLY -> dt.plusWeeks(1)
  627              RecurringInterval.YEARLY -> dt.plusYears(1)
  628              else -> dt.plusMonths(1)
  629          }
  630          return next.atZone(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
  631      }
  632      fun advancePast(nextDueAt: Long, kind: Int, now: Long, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): Long {
  633          var cur = nextDueAt
  634          var guard = 0
  635          while (cur <= now && guard < 240) {
  636              cur = advance(cur, kind, zone)
  637              guard++
  638          }
  639          return cur
  640      }
  641  }

 1006      fun byKey(key: String): ScenePreset = all.firstOrNull { it.key == key } ?: CUSTOM
 1007      fun directionOf(preset: CategoryPreset, scene: ScenePreset): Int =
 1008          if (scene.expenses.contains(preset)) Direction.EXPENSE else Direction.INCOME
 1009      fun displayValue(sceneKey: String, fieldKey: String, raw: String): String {
 1010          if (raw.isBlank()) return ""
 1011          val field = byKey(sceneKey).fields.firstOrNull { it.key == fieldKey } ?: return raw
 1012          return field.options.firstOrNull { it.value == raw }?.label ?: raw
 1013      }
 1014      fun extraSummary(sceneKey: String, extra: Map<String, String>, max: Int = 2): List<String> {
 1015          if (extra.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
 1016          val scene = byKey(sceneKey)
 1017          val out = mutableListOf<String>()
 1018          val known = HashSet<String>()
 1019          scene.fields.forEach { f ->
 1020              known += f.key
 1021              if (out.size >= max) return@forEach
 1022              if (f.key == "state") return@forEach
 1023              val raw = extra[f.key]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: return@forEach
 1024              out += when (f.kind) {
 1025                  FieldKind.CHOICE -> f.options.firstOrNull { it.value == raw }?.label ?: raw
 1026                  else -> "${f.label} $raw"
 1027              }
 1028          }
 1029          if (out.size < max) {
 1030              extra.forEach { (k, v) ->
 1031                  if (k !in known && k != "state" && v.isNotBlank() && out.size < max) out += v
 1032              }
 1033          }
 1034          return out
 1035      }
 1036  }

 1039  package com.foldledger.data
 1040  import org.json.JSONArray
 1041  import org.json.JSONObject
 1042  data class TxnTemplate(
 1043      val id: Long,
 1044      val name: String,
 1045      val direction: Int,
 1046      val categoryName: String,
 1047      val categoryEmoji: String,
 1048      val amountCents: Long,
 1049      val note: String
 1050  )

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 22 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1051  object TxnTemplateCodec {
 1052      fun encode(list: List<TxnTemplate>): String {
 1053          val arr = JSONArray()
 1054          list.forEach { t ->
 1055              arr.put(
 1056                  JSONObject().apply {
 1057                      put("id", t.id)
 1058                      put("name", t.name)
 1059                      put("direction", t.direction)
 1060                      put("categoryName", t.categoryName)
 1061                      put("categoryEmoji", t.categoryEmoji)
 1062                      put("amountCents", t.amountCents)
 1063                      put("note", t.note)
 1064                  }
 1065              )
 1066          }
 1067          return arr.toString()
 1068      }
 1069      fun decode(json: String): List<TxnTemplate> {
 1070          if (json.isBlank()) return emptyList()
 1071          return try {
 1072              val arr = JSONArray(json)
 1073              buildList {
 1074                  for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
 1075                      val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
 1076                      add(
 1077                          TxnTemplate(
 1078                              id = o.optLong("id"),
 1079                              name = o.optString("name"),
 1080                              direction = o.optInt("direction"),
 1081                              categoryName = o.optString("categoryName"),
 1082                              categoryEmoji = o.optString("categoryEmoji"),
 1083                              amountCents = o.optLong("amountCents"),
 1084                              note = o.optString("note")
 1085                          )
 1086                      )
 1087                  }
 1088              }
 1089          } catch (_: Exception) {
 1090              emptyList()
 1091          }
 1092      }
 1093  }

 1119  object BackupFormat {
 1120      const val FORMAT_TAG = "foldledger.backup"
 1121      const val VERSION = 1
 1122      const val EXT_JSON = ".foldledger.json"
 1123      const val EXT_XLSX = ".xlsx"
 1124      const val FILE_PREFIX = "滴水记账-"
 1125      val LEGACY_PREFIXES = listOf("折叠记账-")
 1126      val ALL_PREFIXES: List<String> get() = listOf(FILE_PREFIX) + LEGACY_PREFIXES
 1127      const val AUTO_FILE_NAME = "${FILE_PREFIX}自动备份$EXT_JSON"
 1128      fun isBackupFileName(name: String): Boolean =
 1129          name.endsWith(EXT_JSON) && ALL_PREFIXES.any { name.startsWith(it) }
 1130      fun encode(snapshot: BackupSnapshot): ByteArray {
 1131          val ledgers = JSONArray()
 1132          snapshot.ledgers.forEach { ledgers.put(ledgerToJson(it)) }
 1133          val categories = JSONArray()
 1134          snapshot.categories.forEach { categories.put(categoryToJson(it)) }
 1135          val txns = JSONArray()
 1136          snapshot.transactions.forEach { txns.put(txnToJson(it)) }
 1137          val projects = JSONArray()
 1138          snapshot.projects.forEach { projects.put(projectToJson(it)) }
 1139          val recurring = JSONArray()
 1140          snapshot.recurring.forEach { recurring.put(recurringToJson(it)) }
 1141          val accounts = JSONArray()
 1142          snapshot.accounts.forEach { accounts.put(accountToJson(it)) }
 1143          val sb = StringBuilder(256)
 1144          sb.append("{\"format\":\"").append(FORMAT_TAG).append('"')
 1145          sb.append(",\"version\":").append(VERSION)
 1146          sb.append(",\"appVersion\":\"").append(escapeJson(snapshot.appVersion)).append('"')
 1147          sb.append(",\"exportedAt\":").append(snapshot.exportedAt)
 1148          sb.append(",\"ledgerCount\":").append(snapshot.ledgerCount)
 1149          sb.append(",\"txnCount\":").append(snapshot.txnCount)
 1150          sb.append(",\"ledgers\":").append(ledgers)

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 24 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1151          sb.append(",\"categories\":").append(categories)
 1152          sb.append(",\"transactions\":").append(txns)
 1153          sb.append(",\"projects\":").append(projects)
 1154          sb.append(",\"recurring\":").append(recurring)
 1155          sb.append(",\"accounts\":").append(accounts)
 1156          sb.append('}')
 1157          return sb.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
 1158      }
 1159      private fun escapeJson(s: String): String {
 1160          val sb = StringBuilder(s.length + 8)
 1161          for (c in s) {
 1162              when (c) {
 1163                  '"' -> sb.append("\\\"")
 1164                  '\\' -> sb.append("\\\\")
 1165                  '\n' -> sb.append("\\n")
 1166                  '\r' -> sb.append("\\r")
 1167                  '\t' -> sb.append("\\t")
 1168                  '\b' -> sb.append("\\b")
 1169                  '\u000C' -> sb.append("\\f")
 1170                  else -> if (c.code < 0x20) {
 1171                      sb.append("\\u").append(c.code.toString(16).padStart(4, '0'))
 1172                  } else {
 1173                      sb.append(c)
 1174                  }
 1175              }
 1176          }
 1177          return sb.toString()
 1178      }

 1283      data class Header(
 1284          val exportedAt: Long,
 1285          val ledgerCount: Int,
 1286          val txnCount: Int,
 1287          val appVersion: String
 1288      )
 1289      fun peekHeader(bytes: ByteArray, maxChars: Int = 400): Header? {
 1290          if (bytes.size < 32) return null
 1291          val head = String(bytes, 0, minOf(bytes.size, maxChars), Charsets.UTF_8)
 1292          if (!head.contains(FORMAT_TAG)) return null
 1293          fun num(key: String): Long? =
 1294              Regex("\"" + Regex.escape(key) + "\"\\s*:\\s*(-?\\d+)")
 1295                  .find(head)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toLongOrNull()
 1296          fun str(key: String): String? =
 1297              Regex("\"" + Regex.escape(key) + "\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"")
 1298                  .find(head)?.groupValues?.get(1)
 1299          return Header(
 1300              exportedAt = num("exportedAt") ?: 0L,

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 27 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1301              ledgerCount = (num("ledgerCount") ?: 0L).toInt(),
 1302              txnCount = (num("txnCount") ?: 0L).toInt(),
 1303              appVersion = str("appVersion") ?: "?"
 1304          )
 1305      }
 1306      private fun ledgerToJson(l: LedgerEntity) = JSONObject().apply {
 1307          put("id", l.id)
 1308          put("name", l.name)
 1309          put("sceneKey", l.sceneKey)
 1310          put("emoji", l.emoji)
 1311          put("colorHex", l.colorHex)
 1312          put("budgetCents", l.budgetCents)
 1313          put("note", l.note)
 1314          put("archived", l.archived)
 1315          put("sortOrder", l.sortOrder)
 1316          put("createdAt", l.createdAt)
 1317      }
 1318      private fun categoryToJson(c: CategoryEntity) = JSONObject().apply {
 1319          put("id", c.id)
 1320          put("ledgerId", c.ledgerId)
 1321          put("name", c.name)
 1322          put("emoji", c.emoji)

 1384      private inline fun <T> JSONArray?.toList(map: (JSONObject) -> T): List<T> {
 1385          if (this == null) return emptyList()
 1386          val out = ArrayList<T>(length())
 1387          for (i in 0 until length()) {
 1388              val o = optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
 1389              out += map(o)
 1390          }
 1391          return out
 1392      }

 1401  import com.foldledger.data.repo.LedgerRepository
 1402  import com.foldledger.data.repo.RestoreStats
 1403  import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
 1404  import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
 1405  import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
 1406  import java.util.Date
 1407  import java.util.Locale
 1408  class BackupManager(
 1409      private val context: Context,
 1410      private val repo: LedgerRepository
 1411  ) {
 1412      private val saf = SafFolderStore(context)
 1413      companion object {
 1414          const val MIME_JSON = "application/json"
 1415          const val MIME_XLSX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
 1416          const val KEEP_MANUAL = 10
 1417      }
 1418      data class ExportOutcome(
 1419          val folderLabel: String,
 1420          val jsonName: String,
 1421          val xlsxName: String,
 1422          val ledgerCount: Int,
 1423          val txnCount: Int,
 1424          val totalBytes: Int,
 1425          val prunedFiles: Int,
 1426          val isAuto: Boolean
 1427      )
 1428      data class BackupEntry(
 1429          val docId: String,
 1430          val fileName: String,
 1431          val savedAt: Long,
 1432          val ledgerCount: Int,
 1433          val txnCount: Int,
 1434          val appVersion: String,
 1435          val sizeBytes: Long,
 1436          val isAuto: Boolean
 1437      )
 1438      fun hasPermission(treeUri: Uri): Boolean = saf.hasPermission(treeUri)
 1439      fun takePermission(treeUri: Uri): Boolean = saf.takePersistablePermission(treeUri)
 1440      fun folderLabel(treeUri: Uri): String = saf.folderLabel(treeUri)
 1441      fun release(treeUri: Uri) = saf.releasePermission(treeUri)
 1442      suspend fun export(treeUri: Uri, auto: Boolean): ExportOutcome = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 1443          val snapshot = repo.snapshot()
 1444          if (snapshot.ledgerCount == 0 && !auto) {
 1445              error("还没有任何账本，没什么可备份的")
 1446          }
 1447          val stamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.CHINA)
 1448              .format(Date(snapshot.exportedAt))
 1449          val jsonName = if (auto) {
 1450              BackupFormat.AUTO_FILE_NAME

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 30 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1451          } else {
 1452              "${BackupFormat.FILE_PREFIX}备份-$stamp${BackupFormat.EXT_JSON}"
 1453          }
 1454          val xlsxName = jsonName.removeSuffix(BackupFormat.EXT_JSON) + BackupFormat.EXT_XLSX
 1455          val jsonBytes = BackupFormat.encode(snapshot)
 1456          val excelBytes = ExcelExporter(repo).build(snapshot.ledgers, snapshot.transactions).bytes
 1457          val okJson = saf.writeFile(treeUri, jsonName, MIME_JSON, jsonBytes)
 1458          if (!okJson) error("写入备份目录失败，请重新选择备份文件夹")
 1459          val okXlsx = saf.writeFile(treeUri, xlsxName, MIME_XLSX, excelBytes)
 1460          val pruned = if (auto) 0 else prune(treeUri)
 1461          ExportOutcome(
 1462              folderLabel = saf.folderLabel(treeUri),
 1463              jsonName = jsonName,
 1464              xlsxName = xlsxName,
 1465              ledgerCount = snapshot.ledgerCount,
 1466              txnCount = snapshot.txnCount,
 1467              totalBytes = jsonBytes.size + if (okXlsx) excelBytes.size else 0,
 1468              prunedFiles = pruned,
 1469              isAuto = auto
 1470          )
 1471      }
 1472      private fun prune(treeUri: Uri): Int {
 1473          val files = runCatching { saf.listFiles(treeUri) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
 1474          val manualJson = files
 1475              .filter {
 1476                  BackupFormat.isBackupFileName(it.name) &&
 1477                      it.name != BackupFormat.AUTO_FILE_NAME
 1478              }
 1479              .sortedByDescending { it.lastModified }
 1480          var deleted = 0
 1481          manualJson.drop(KEEP_MANUAL).forEach { old ->
 1482              val base = old.name.removeSuffix(BackupFormat.EXT_JSON)
 1483              if (saf.delete(treeUri, old.docId)) deleted++
 1484              files.firstOrNull { it.name == base + BackupFormat.EXT_XLSX }?.let {
 1485                  if (saf.delete(treeUri, it.docId)) deleted++
 1486              }
 1487          }
 1488          return deleted
 1489      }
 1490      suspend fun listBackups(treeUri: Uri): List<BackupEntry> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 1491          val files = runCatching { saf.listFiles(treeUri) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
 1492          files.asSequence()
 1493              .filter { BackupFormat.isBackupFileName(it.name) }
 1494              .mapNotNull { f ->
 1495                  val head = runCatching {
 1496                      context.contentResolver
 1497                          .openInputStream(
 1498                              android.provider.DocumentsContract
 1499                                  .buildDocumentUriUsingTree(treeUri, f.docId)
 1500                          )

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 31 页

 1501  /* …… 中间 414 页按登记要求省略 …… */
 1502      fun load(context: Context, fileName: String): Bitmap? {
 1503          cache.get(fileName)?.let { return it }
 1504          val f = fileOf(context, fileName)
 1505          if (!f.isFile) return null
 1506          val bmp = runCatching { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(f.absolutePath) }.getOrNull() ?: return null
 1507          cache.put(fileName, bmp)
 1508          return bmp
 1509      }
 1510      fun remove(context: Context, fileName: String) {
 1511          cache.remove(fileName)
 1512          runCatching { fileOf(context, fileName).delete() }
 1513      }
 1514      private fun decodeBounded(context: Context, uri: Uri): Bitmap? {
 1515          val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
 1516          runCatching {
 1517              context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {
 1518                  BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, bounds)
 1519              }
 1520          }
 1521          if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return null
 1522          var sample = 1
 1523          while (bounds.outWidth / (sample * 2) >= TARGET_PX &&
 1524              bounds.outHeight / (sample * 2) >= TARGET_PX
 1525          ) {
 1526              sample *= 2
 1527          }
 1528          val opts = BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
 1529              inSampleSize = sample
 1530              inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888
 1531          }
 1532          return runCatching {
 1533              context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {
 1534                  BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, opts)
 1535              }
 1536          }.getOrNull()
 1537      }
 1538      private fun cropToSquare(src: Bitmap, size: Int): Bitmap {
 1539          val side = minOf(src.width, src.height)
 1540          val x = (src.width - side) / 2
 1541          val y = (src.height - side) / 2
 1542          val cropped = Bitmap.createBitmap(src, x, y, side, side)
 1543          if (cropped.width == size && cropped.height == size) return cropped
 1544          val scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(cropped, size, size, true)
 1545          if (scaled !== cropped) cropped.recycle()
 1546          return scaled
 1547      }
 1548  }

 1633  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/util/Money.kt */
 1634  package com.foldledger.util
 1635  import java.math.BigDecimal
 1636  import java.math.RoundingMode
 1637  import kotlin.math.abs
 1638  object Money {
 1639      fun centsToPlain(cents: Long): String {
 1640          val neg = cents < 0
 1641          val v = abs(cents)
 1642          val s = "${v / 100}.${(v % 100).toString().padStart(2, '0')}"
 1643          return if (neg) "-$s" else s
 1644      }
 1645      fun format(cents: Long, symbol: Boolean = true): String {
 1646          val neg = cents < 0
 1647          val v = abs(cents)
 1648          val yuan = v / 100
 1649          val fen = v % 100
 1650          val grouped = yuan.toString().reversed().chunked(3).joinToString(",").reversed()

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 34 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1651          val sb = StringBuilder()
 1652          if (neg) sb.append('-')
 1653          if (symbol) sb.append('¥')
 1654          sb.append(grouped)
 1655          if (fen != 0L) sb.append('.').append(fen.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
 1656          return sb.toString()
 1657      }
 1658      fun formatCompact(cents: Long): String {
 1659          val yuan = abs(cents) / 100.0
 1660          val sign = if (cents < 0) "-" else ""
 1661          return when {
 1662              yuan >= 100_000_000 -> sign + trimZero(yuan / 100_000_000) + "亿"
 1663              yuan >= 10_000 -> sign + trimZero(yuan / 10_000) + "万"
 1664              else -> format(cents)
 1665          }
 1666      }
 1667      private fun trimZero(v: Double): String {
 1668          val s = String.format("%.2f", v)
 1669          return s.trimEnd('0').trimEnd('.')
 1670      }
 1671      fun parseToCents(input: String): Long? {
 1672          val t = input.trim().replace("¥", "").replace(",", "")
 1673          if (t.isEmpty() || t == "." || t == "-") return null
 1674          return try {
 1675              BigDecimal(t)
 1676                  .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
 1677                  .movePointRight(2)
 1678                  .longValueExact()
 1679          } catch (_: Exception) {
 1680              null
 1681          }
 1682      }
 1683      fun percent(part: Long, total: Long): String {
 1684          if (total <= 0) return "0%"
 1685          val p = part.toDouble() / total.toDouble() * 100
 1686          return String.format("%.1f%%", p)
 1687      }
 1688  }

 1750      private val RE_CN_DECIMAL = Regex("""([零〇一壹二两贰三叁四肆五伍六陆七柒八捌九玖]{1,3})\s*(?:块|元|钱)\s*([零〇一壹二两贰三叁四肆五伍六陆七柒八捌九玖]{1,2})""")

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 36 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1751      private val RE_CN_BARE = Regex("""([零〇一壹二两贰三叁四肆五伍六陆七柒八捌九玖十拾百佰千仟]{1,8})""")
 1752      private val DATE_PATTERNS: List<Pair<Regex, (MatchResult, LocalDate) -> LocalDate>> = listOf(
 1753          Regex("大前天") to { _, d -> d.minusDays(3) },
 1754          Regex("前天") to { _, d -> d.minusDays(2) },
 1755          Regex("昨天|昨儿|昨晚") to { _, d -> d.minusDays(1) },
 1756          Regex("今天|今日|今儿|今晚") to { _, d -> d },
 1757          Regex("""(上|这|本)?(?:周|星期|礼拜)([一二三四五六日天1-7])?""") to { m, d ->
 1758              val weeksBack = if (m.groupValues[1] == "上") 1L else 0L
 1759              weekAnchor(d, m.groupValues.getOrNull(2), weeksBack)
 1760          },
 1761          Regex("""(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})[号日]""") to { m, d ->
 1762              val mo = m.groupValues[1].toIntOrNull() ?: return@to d
 1763              val day = m.groupValues[2].toIntOrNull() ?: return@to d
 1764              if (mo !in 1..12 || day !in 1..31) d
 1765              else runCatching { LocalDate.of(d.year, mo, day) }.getOrDefault(d)
 1766          },
 1767          Regex("""(\d{1,2})[号日]""") to { m, d ->
 1768              val day = m.groupValues[1].toIntOrNull() ?: return@to d
 1769              if (day !in 1..31) d
 1770              else runCatching { LocalDate.of(d.year, d.monthValue, day) }.getOrDefault(d)
 1771          }
 1772      )
 1773      private val WEEKDAY_MAP = mapOf(
 1774          "一" to 1, "二" to 2, "三" to 3, "四" to 4, "五" to 5, "六" to 6, "日" to 7, "天" to 7,
 1775          "1" to 1, "2" to 2, "3" to 3, "4" to 4, "5" to 5, "6" to 6, "7" to 7
 1776      )
 1777      fun parse(
 1778          text: String,
 1779          now: Long,
 1780          zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()
 1781      ): NlIntent? {
 1782          val raw = text.trim()
 1783          if (raw.isEmpty()) return null
 1784          val today = LocalDate.ofInstant(java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(now), zone)
 1785          val (date, dateRanges) = extractDate(raw, today)
 1786          var work = raw
 1787          dateRanges.sortedByDescending { it.first }.forEach { r ->
 1788              val s = r.first
 1789              val e = r.last + 1
 1790              if (s in 0..work.length && e in 0..work.length && e > s) {
 1791                  work = work.removeRange(s, e)
 1792              }
 1793          }
 1794          val amount = extractAmount(work) ?: return null
 1795          val direction = extractDirection(raw)
 1796          val hint = extractCategoryHint(raw)
 1797          val note = work
 1798              .replace(RE_ARABIC, "")
 1799              .replace(RE_CN_NUMBER, "")
 1800              .replace(RE_CN_DECIMAL, "")

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 37 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1801              .replace(RE_ARABIC_BARE, "")
 1802              .replace(RE_CN_BARE, "")
 1803              .trim()
 1804              .trim('，', ',', '。', '.', ' ', '\t', '的', '了', '花', '付')
 1805              .take(40)
 1806          val millis = applyTimeOfDay(date, raw, zone)
 1807          val confidence = when {
 1808              hint != null && amount > 0 -> 0.9f
 1809              hint != null -> 0.7f
 1810              else -> 0.4f
 1811          }
 1812          return NlIntent(
 1813              direction = direction,
 1814              amountCents = amount,
 1815              dateMillis = millis,
 1816              categoryHint = hint,
 1817              note = note,
 1818              confidence = confidence
 1819          )
 1820      }
 1821      fun extractAmount(text: String): Long? {
 1822          RE_ARABIC.find(text)?.let {
 1823              val v = it.groupValues[1].toDoubleOrNull()
 1824              if (v != null && v > 0) return toCents(v)
 1825          }
 1826          RE_CN_DECIMAL.find(text)?.let {
 1827              val a = cnToInt(it.groupValues[1])
 1828              val b = cnToInt(it.groupValues[2])
 1829              if (a != null && b != null && a > 0 && b in 0..9) return toCents(a + b / 10.0)
 1830          }
 1831          RE_CN_NUMBER.find(text)?.let {
 1832              val v = cnToInt(it.groupValues[1])
 1833              if (v != null && v > 0) return v * 100
 1834          }
 1835          RE_ARABIC_BARE.findAll(text).lastOrNull()?.let {
 1836              val v = it.groupValues[1].toDoubleOrNull()
 1837              if (v != null && v > 0) return toCents(v)
 1838          }
 1839          RE_CN_BARE.findAll(text).lastOrNull()?.let {
 1840              val v = cnToInt(it.groupValues[1])
 1841              if (v != null && v > 0) return v * 100
 1842          }
 1843          return null
 1844      }
 1845      private fun toCents(v: Double): Long = Math.round(v * 100).toLong()
 1846      fun cnToInt(s: String): Long? {
 1847          if (s.isBlank()) return null
 1848          if (s.length == 3 && (s[1] == '百' || s[1] == '佰')) {
 1849              val h = CN_DIGITS[s[0]] ?: return null
 1850              val t = CN_DIGITS[s[2]] ?: return null

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 38 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1851              if (t > 0) return h * 100L + t * 10L
 1852          }
 1853          var total = 0L
 1854          var section = 0L
 1855          var number = 0L
 1856          var any = false
 1857          for (ch in s) {
 1858              when {
 1859                  CN_DIGITS.containsKey(ch) -> {
 1860                      number = CN_DIGITS.getValue(ch).toLong()
 1861                      any = true
 1862                  }
 1863                  CN_UNITS.containsKey(ch) -> {
 1864                      val unit = CN_UNITS.getValue(ch).toLong()
 1865                      any = true
 1866                      section += (if (number == 0L) 1L else number) * unit
 1867                      number = 0L
 1868                      if (unit >= 1000L) {
 1869                          total += section
 1870                          section = 0L
 1871                      }
 1872                  }
 1873                  else -> return null
 1874              }
 1875          }
 1876          if (!any) return null
 1877          val result = total + section + number
 1878          return if (result > 0) result else null
 1879      }
 1880      private fun extractDate(text: String, today: LocalDate): Pair<LocalDate, List<IntRange>> {
 1881          for ((re, resolve) in DATE_PATTERNS) {
 1882              val m = re.find(text) ?: continue
 1883              val date = resolve(m, today)
 1884              if (date != today || m.value.isNotEmpty()) {
 1885                  return date to listOf(m.range)
 1886              }
 1887          }
 1888          return today to emptyList()
 1889      }
 1890      private fun weekAnchor(today: LocalDate, weekdayRaw: String?, weeksBack: Long): LocalDate {
 1891          val w = weekdayRaw?.let { WEEKDAY_MAP[it] }
 1892          if (w == null) {
 1893              return today.minusWeeks(weeksBack.coerceAtLeast(1))
 1894          }
 1895          val todayIdx = today.dayOfWeek.value // 周一=1..周日=7
 1896          var delta = (todayIdx - w).toLong()
 1897          if (delta < 0) delta += 7
 1898          var date = today.minusDays(delta)
 1899          if (weeksBack > 0) date = date.minusWeeks(weeksBack)
 1900          return date

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 39 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1901      }
 1902      private fun applyTimeOfDay(date: LocalDate, text: String, zone: ZoneId): Long {
 1903          val hour = when {
 1904              text.contains("早上") || text.contains("上午") -> 9
 1905              text.contains("中午") -> 12
 1906              text.contains("下午") -> 15
 1907              text.contains("晚上") || text.contains("傍晚") || text.contains("夜里") -> 20
 1908              text.contains("凌晨") -> 2
 1909              else -> 12
 1910          }
 1911          return date.atTime(hour, 0).atZone(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
 1912      }
 1913      fun extractDirection(text: String): Int {
 1914          val income = INCOME_WORDS.any { text.contains(it) }
 1915          val expense = EXPENSE_WORDS.any { text.contains(it) }
 1916          return when {
 1917              income && !expense -> Direction.INCOME
 1918              income && expense -> {
 1919                  val i = INCOME_WORDS.map { text.indexOf(it) }.filter { it >= 0 }.minOrNull() ?: Int.MAX_VALUE
 1920                  val e = EXPENSE_WORDS.map { text.indexOf(it) }.filter { it >= 0 }.minOrNull() ?: Int.MAX_VALUE
 1921                  if (i <= e) Direction.INCOME else Direction.EXPENSE
 1922              }
 1923              else -> Direction.EXPENSE
 1924          }
 1925      }
 1926      fun extractCategoryHint(text: String): String? {
 1927          val lower = text.lowercase()
 1928          for ((kw, cat) in CATEGORY_HINTS) {
 1929              if (lower.contains(kw.lowercase())) return cat
 1930          }
 1931          return null
 1932      }
 1933  }

 1980      fun parseNotification(pkg: String, title: String, text: String, postTime: Long): ParsedPayment? {
 1981          val all = "$title $text".trim()
 1982          if (all.isEmpty()) return null
 1983          if (!looksLikePayment(all)) return null
 1984          val amount = extractAmount(all) ?: return null
 1985          val direction = extractDirection(all)
 1986          val source = PKG_SOURCES[pkg] ?: title.ifBlank { "支付通知" }
 1987          return ParsedPayment(
 1988              direction = direction,
 1989              amountCents = amount,
 1990              merchant = extractMerchant(all) ?: source,
 1991              source = source,
 1992              atMillis = if (postTime > 0) postTime else null
 1993          )
 1994      }
 1995      fun parseSms(body: String): ParsedPayment? {

 1998          if (!looksLikePayment(all)) return null

 2000          val direction = extractDirection(all)

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 41 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2001          val card = CARD_TAIL.find(all)?.groupValues?.get(1)
 2002          val merchant = extractMerchant(all)
 2003              ?: (if (card != null) "尾号${card}银行卡" else "银行短信")
 2004          return ParsedPayment(
 2005              direction = direction,
 2006              amountCents = amount,
 2007              merchant = merchant,
 2008              source = "银行短信",
 2009              atMillis = null // 短信解析文本里的日期不可靠，用接收时间（调用方给）
 2010          )
 2011      }
 2012      fun looksLikePayment(text: String): Boolean =
 2013          PAYMENT_HINTS.any { text.contains(it) }
 2014      fun extractAmount(text: String): Long? {
 2015          for (p in AMOUNT_PATTERNS) {
 2016              val m = p.find(text) ?: continue
 2017              val v = m.groupValues[1].replace(",", "").toDoubleOrNull() ?: continue
 2018              if (v <= 0 || v > 10_000_000) continue // 0 元/离谱大数不是正常支付
 2019              return (v * 100).toLong()
 2020          }
 2021          return null
 2022      }
 2023      fun extractDirection(text: String): Int {
 2024          val income = INCOME_HINTS.any { text.contains(it) }
 2025          if (income) return Direction.INCOME
 2026          return Direction.EXPENSE
 2027      }
 2028      fun extractMerchant(text: String): String? {
 2029          for (p in MERCHANT_PATTERNS) {
 2030              val m = p.find(text) ?: continue
 2031              val raw = m.groupValues[1].trim().trim('「', '」', '『', '』', ':', '：', ' ', '\t')
 2032              if (raw.isNotBlank() && !raw.all { it.isDigit() }) return raw.take(24)
 2033          }
 2034          return null
 2035      }

 2038  /* 文件: app/src/main/java/com/foldledger/util/RecurringDetector.kt */
 2039  package com.foldledger.util
 2040  import com.foldledger.data.db.Direction
 2041  import com.foldledger.data.db.RecurringInterval
 2042  import com.foldledger.data.db.TransactionEntity
 2043  object RecurringDetector {
 2044      data class Suggestion(
 2045          val name: String,
 2046          val categoryEmoji: String,
 2047          val categoryId: Long?,
 2048          val direction: Int,
 2049          val amountCents: Long,
 2050          val intervalKind: Int,

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 42 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2051          val occurrences: Int,
 2052          val lastAt: Long,
 2053          val predictedNextAt: Long,
 2054          val avgGapDays: Int
 2055      )
 2056      fun detect(
 2057          txns: List<TransactionEntity>,
 2058          now: Long,
 2059          excludeNames: Set<String> = emptySet(),
 2060          lookbackDays: Int = 210
 2061      ): List<Suggestion> {
 2062          val since = now - lookbackDays * 24L * 3600 * 1000
 2063          val candidates = txns.filter {
 2064              it.occurredAt in since..now && it.categoryName.isNotBlank()
 2065          }
 2066          return candidates
 2067              .groupBy { it.categoryName to it.direction }
 2068              .mapNotNull { (key, group) ->
 2069                  if (group.size < 3 || key.first in excludeNames) return@mapNotNull null
 2070                  analyze(group)
 2071              }
 2072              .sortedByDescending { it.occurrences }
 2073      }
 2074      private fun analyze(group: List<TransactionEntity>): Suggestion? {
 2075          val sorted = group.sortedBy { it.occurredAt }
 2076          val amounts = sorted.map { it.amountCents }.sorted()
 2077          val median = amounts[amounts.size / 2]
 2078          if (median <= 0L) return null
 2079          val spread = (amounts.last() - amounts.first()).toFloat() / median
 2080          if (spread > 0.35f) return null
 2081          val gaps = ArrayList<Int>(sorted.size - 1)
 2082          for (i in 1 until sorted.size) {
 2083              val d = ReimburseAging.ageDays(sorted[i - 1].occurredAt, sorted[i].occurredAt)
 2084              if (d <= 0) return null // 同天多笔不是周期
 2085              gaps += d
 2086          }
 2087          val gapMedian = gaps.sorted()[gaps.size / 2]
 2088          if (gapMedian <= 0) return null
 2089          if (gaps.any { it < gapMedian * 0.65 || it > gapMedian * 1.35 + 1 }) return null
 2090          val kind = when (gapMedian) {
 2091              in 4..10 -> RecurringInterval.WEEKLY
 2092              in 24..38 -> RecurringInterval.MONTHLY
 2093              in 330..400 -> RecurringInterval.YEARLY
 2094              else -> return null // 什么周期都不是（比如 15 天一次）
 2095          }
 2096          val last = sorted.last()
 2097          return Suggestion(
 2098              name = last.categoryName,
 2099              categoryEmoji = last.categoryEmoji,
 2100              categoryId = last.categoryId,

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 43 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2101              direction = last.direction,
 2102              amountCents = median,
 2103              intervalKind = kind,
 2104              occurrences = sorted.size,
 2105              lastAt = last.occurredAt,
 2106              predictedNextAt = last.occurredAt + gapMedian * 24L * 3600 * 1000,
 2107              avgGapDays = gapMedian
 2108          )
 2109      }
 2110  }

 2123      ) {

 2127          val buckets: List<Bucket>,
 2128          val oldestDays: Int,
 2129          val overdueCents: Long,
 2130          val overdueCount: Int
 2131      ) {

 2134          }
 2135      }
 2136      fun ageDays(occurredAt: Long, now: Long): Int {
 2137          val d1 = java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(occurredAt)
 2138              .atZone(java.time.ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate()
 2139          val d2 = java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(now)
 2140              .atZone(java.time.ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate()
 2141          return java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(d1, d2).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
 2142      }
 2143      fun summarize(outstanding: List<TransactionEntity>, now: Long): Summary {
 2144          if (outstanding.isEmpty()) return Summary.EMPTY
 2145          val b1 = ArrayList<TransactionEntity>() // 0-7
 2146          val b2 = ArrayList<TransactionEntity>() // 8-30
 2147          val b3 = ArrayList<TransactionEntity>() // 31-90
 2148          val b4 = ArrayList<TransactionEntity>() // 91+
 2149          var oldest = 0
 2150          outstanding.forEach { t ->

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 44 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2151              val d = ageDays(t.occurredAt, now)
 2152              if (d > oldest) oldest = d
 2153              when {
 2154                  d <= 7 -> b1 += t
 2155                  d <= 30 -> b2 += t
 2156                  d <= 90 -> b3 += t
 2157                  else -> b4 += t
 2158              }

 2160          fun agg(label: String, from: Int, to: Int, l: List<TransactionEntity>) = Bucket(
 2161              label = label, daysFrom = from, daysTo = to,
 2162              cents = l.sumOf { it.amountCents }, count = l.size
 2163          )

 2166                  agg("7 天内", 0, 7, b1),
 2167                  agg("8–30 天", 8, 30, b2),
 2168                  agg("31–90 天", 31, 90, b3),
 2169                  agg("90 天+", 91, Int.MAX_VALUE, b4)
 2170              ),
 2171              oldestDays = oldest,
 2172              overdueCents = b3.sumOf { it.amountCents } + b4.sumOf { it.amountCents },
 2173              overdueCount = b3.size + b4.size
 2174          )
 2175      }
 2176      fun chaseSummary(
 2177          ledgerName: String,
 2178          outstanding: List<TransactionEntity>,

 2186          val pending = outstanding.filter { it.reimburseState == ReimburseState.PENDING }
 2187          val submitted = outstanding.filter { it.reimburseState == ReimburseState.SUBMITTED }
 2188          val oldestDays = sorted.maxOf { ageDays(it.occurredAt, now) }
 2189          val total = outstanding.sumOf { it.amountCents }
 2190          val sb = StringBuilder()
 2191          sb.appendLine("【报销对账】$ledgerName")
 2192          if (pending.isNotEmpty()) {

 2194          }

 2197          }
 2198          sb.appendLine("合计未回款 ${Money.format(total)}（最久已垫付 $oldestDays 天）")
 2199          sb.appendLine("明细（按垫付时间从久到近）：")
 2200          sorted.take(maxItems).forEach { t ->

------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2201              val d = ageDays(t.occurredAt, now)
 2202              val project = projectNames[t.projectId]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { "·$it" } ?: ""
 2203              sb.appendLine(
 2204                  "· ${DateExt.shortDay(t.occurredAt)} ${t.categoryName}$project " +
 2205                      "${Money.format(t.amountCents)}（压了 $d 天）"
 2206              )
 2207          }
 2208          if (sorted.size > maxItems) {
 2209              sb.appendLine("· …等共 ${sorted.size} 笔")
 2210          }
 2211          sb.append("麻烦帮忙跟进一下，谢谢～")
 2212          return sb.toString()
 2213      }
 2214  }

 2378      private fun worksheet(sheet: Sheet): ByteArray {
 2379          val sb = StringBuilder(8 * 1024)
 2380          sb.append("""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>""")

 2382          sb.append("""<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0">""")
 2383          if (sheet.freezeFirstRow && sheet.rows.isNotEmpty()) {
 2384              sb.append("""<pane ySplit="1" topLeftCell="A2" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/>""")
 2385              sb.append("""<selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="A2" sqref="A2"/>""")
 2386          } else {
 2387              sb.append("""<selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>""")
 2388          }
 2389          sb.append("</sheetView></sheetViews>")
 2390          sb.append("""<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="16.5"/>""")
 2391          sheet.widths?.let { ws ->
 2392              if (ws.isNotEmpty()) {
 2393                  sb.append("<cols>")
 2394                  ws.forEachIndexed { i, w ->
 2395                      sb.append("""<col min="${i + 1}" max="${i + 1}" width="$w" customWidth="1"/>""")
 2396                  }
 2397                  sb.append("</cols>")
 2398              }
 2399          }
 2400          sb.append("<sheetData>")

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 49 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2401          sheet.rows.forEachIndexed { rIndex, row ->
 2402              if (row.isEmpty()) {
 2403                  sb.append("""<row r="${rIndex + 1}"/>""")
 2404                  return@forEachIndexed
 2405              }
 2406              val isHeader = row.firstOrNull()?.style == STYLE_HEADER
 2407              sb.append("""<row r="${rIndex + 1}"""")
 2408              if (isHeader) sb.append(""" ht="24" customHeight="1"""")
 2409              sb.append(">")
 2410              row.forEachIndexed { cIndex, cell ->
 2411                  writeCell(sb, rIndex, cIndex, cell)
 2412              }
 2413              sb.append("</row>")
 2414          }
 2415          sb.append("</sheetData>")
 2416          sb.append("""<pageMargins left="0.4" right="0.4" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>""")
 2417          sb.append("</worksheet>")
 2418          return sb.toUtf8()

 2420      private fun writeCell(sb: StringBuilder, rowIndex: Int, colIndex: Int, cell: Cell) {
 2421          val ref = "${colLetter(colIndex)}${rowIndex + 1}"
 2422          val v = cell.value
 2423          when (v) {
 2424              null -> sb.append("""<c r="$ref" s="${cell.style}"/>""")
 2425              is Number -> {
 2426                  val d = v.toDouble()
 2427                  if (d.isNaN() || d.isInfinite()) {
 2428                      sb.append("""<c r="$ref" s="${cell.style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve"></t></is></c>""")
 2429                  } else {
 2430                      sb.append("""<c r="$ref" s="${cell.style}"><v>${num(d)}</v></c>""")
 2431                  }
 2432              }
 2433              is Boolean -> sb.append("""<c r="$ref" s="${cell.style}" t="b"><v>${if (v) 1 else 0}</v></c>""")
 2434              else -> {
 2435                  val s = esc(v.toString())
 2436                  sb.append("""<c r="$ref" s="${cell.style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">$s</t></is></c>""")
 2437              }
 2438          }
 2439      }
 2440      fun colLetter(index0: Int): String {
 2441          var n = index0 + 1
 2442          val sb = StringBuilder(2)
 2443          while (n > 0) {
 2444              val rem = (n - 1) % 26
 2445              sb.append(('A'.code + rem).toChar())
 2446              n = (n - 1) / 26
 2447          }
 2448          return sb.reverse().toString()
 2449      }
 2450      fun toExcelSerial(epochMillis: Long): Double {

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 50 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2451          val tzOffsetMinutes = java.util.TimeZone.getDefault().getOffset(epochMillis) / 60_000.0
 2452          return epochMillis / 86_400_000.0 + 25_569.0 + tzOffsetMinutes / 1_440.0
 2453      }
 2454      private fun num(d: Double): String {
 2455          val r = Math.round(d * 1_000_000.0) / 1_000_000.0
 2456          return if (r == r.toLong().toDouble()) r.toLong().toString() else r.toString()
 2457      }
 2458      private fun sanitizeSheetName(raw: String, used: MutableSet<String>): String {
 2459          var n = raw.replace(Regex("[\\[\\]:*?/\\\\]"), "_").trim().trim('\'').take(31)
 2460          if (n.isBlank()) n = "Sheet"
 2461          var candidate = n
 2462          var i = 2
 2463          while (!used.add(candidate)) {
 2464              val suffix = "_$i"
 2465              candidate = n.take(31 - suffix.length) + suffix
 2466              i++
 2467          }
 2468          return candidate
 2469      }
 2470      private fun isoNow(): String {
 2471          val fmt = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", java.util.Locale.US)
 2472          fmt.timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
 2473          return fmt.format(java.util.Date())
 2474      }
 2475      private fun esc(input: String): String {
 2476          val sb = StringBuilder(input.length + 16)
 2477          for (ch in input) {
 2478              when (ch) {
 2479                  '&' -> sb.append("&amp;")
 2480                  '<' -> sb.append("&lt;")
 2481                  '>' -> sb.append("&gt;")
 2482                  '"' -> sb.append("&quot;")
 2483                  '\'' -> sb.append("&apos;")
 2484                  '\n' -> sb.append("&#10;")
 2485                  '\r' -> sb.append("&#13;")
 2486                  '\t' -> sb.append("&#9;")
 2487                  else -> if (ch.code >= 0x20 || ch.code == 0x09) sb.append(ch)
 2488              }
 2489          }
 2490          return sb.toString()
 2491      }
 2492      private fun String.toUtf8(): ByteArray = toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
 2493      private fun StringBuilder.toUtf8(): ByteArray = toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
 2494  }

 2497  pub fn fnv1a(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
 2498      let mut h: u32 = 0x811c9dc5;
 2499      for &b in data {
 2500          h ^= b as u32;

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 51 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2501          h = h.wrapping_mul(0x01000193);
 2502      }
 2503      h
 2504  }
 2505  #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 2506  pub struct BackupSummary {
 2507      pub is_drip_backup: bool,
 2508      pub version: i32,
 2509      pub ledger_count: i64,
 2510      pub txn_count: i64,
 2511  }
 2512  pub fn peek(json: &str) -> BackupSummary {
 2513      let is_drip = json.contains("\"format\":\"foldledger.backup\"");
 2514      BackupSummary {
 2515          is_drip_backup: is_drip,
 2516          version: json_int(json, "version").unwrap_or(0) as i32,
 2517          ledger_count: json_int(json, "ledgerCount").unwrap_or(0),
 2518          txn_count: json_int(json, "txnCount").unwrap_or(0),
 2519      }
 2520  }
 2521  pub fn validate(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
 2522      let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes);
 2523      let summary = peek(&s);
 2524      summary.is_drip_backup
 2525          && (1..=2).contains(&summary.version)
 2526          && s.contains("\"ledgers\":")
 2527          && s.contains("\"transactions\":")
 2528  }
 2529  fn json_int(text: &str, key: &str) -> Option<i64> {
 2530      let pat = format!("\"{key}\":");
 2531      let idx = text.find(&pat)?;
 2532      let rest = &text[idx + pat.len()..];
 2533      let num: String = rest
 2534          .chars()
 2535          .take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || *c == '-')
 2536          .collect();
 2537      if num.is_empty() || num == "-" {
 2538          None
 2539      } else {
 2540          num.parse().ok()
 2541      }
 2542  }

 2670  /* 文件: rust/drip-core/src/money.rs */
 2671  pub fn to_plain(cents: i64) -> String {
 2672      let neg = cents < 0;
 2673      let v = cents.unsigned_abs();
 2674      let s = format!("{}.{:02}", v / 100, v % 100);
 2675      if neg {
 2676          format!("-{s}")
 2677      } else {
 2678          s
 2679      }
 2680  }
 2681  pub fn format_cents(cents: i64, symbol: bool) -> String {
 2682      let neg = cents < 0;
 2683      let v = cents.unsigned_abs();
 2684      let yuan = v / 100;
 2685      let fen = v % 100;
 2686      let grouped = group_thousands(yuan);
 2687      let mut out = String::with_capacity(grouped.len() + 6);
 2688      if neg {
 2689          out.push('-');
 2690      }
 2691      if symbol {
 2692          out.push('¥');
 2693      }
 2694      out.push_str(&grouped);
 2695      if fen != 0 {
 2696          out.push('.');
 2697          out.push_str(&format!("{fen:02}"));
 2698      }
 2699      out
 2700  }

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 55 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2701  pub fn format_compact(cents: i64) -> String {
 2702      let neg = cents < 0;
 2703      let sign = if neg { "-" } else { "" };
 2704      let yuan = cents.unsigned_abs() as f64 / 100.0;
 2705      if yuan >= 100_000_000.0 {
 2706          format!("{sign}{}亿", trim_zero(yuan / 100_000_000.0))
 2707      } else if yuan >= 10_000.0 {
 2708          format!("{sign}{}万", trim_zero(yuan / 10_000.0))
 2709      } else {
 2710          format_cents(cents, true)
 2711      }
 2712  }
 2713  pub fn parse_to_cents(input: &str) -> Option<i64> {
 2714      let t = input.trim().replace('¥', "").replace(',', "");
 2715      if t.is_empty() || t == "." || t == "-" {
 2716          return None;
 2717      }
 2718      let (int_part, frac_part) = match t.split_once('.') {
 2719          Some((i, f)) => (i, f),
 2720          None => (t.as_str(), ""),
 2721      };
 2722      let (neg, digits) = match int_part.strip_prefix('-') {
 2723          Some(rest) => (true, rest),
 2724          None => (false, int_part),
 2725      };
 2726      if digits.is_empty() || !digits.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {
 2727          return None;
 2728      }
 2729      if !frac_part.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {
 2730          return None;
 2731      }
 2732      let mut frac = String::new();
 2733      frac.push(frac_part.as_bytes().get(0).map(|&c| c as char).unwrap_or('0'));
 2734      frac.push(frac_part.as_bytes().get(1).map(|&c| c as char).unwrap_or('0'));
 2735      let mut round_up = false;
 2736      if frac_part.len() > 2 {
 2737          round_up = frac_part.as_bytes()[2] >= b'5';
 2738      }
 2739      let yuan: i64 = digits.parse().ok()?;
 2740      let mut cents = yuan * 100 + frac.parse::<i64>().ok()?;
 2741      if round_up {
 2742          cents += 1;
 2743      }
 2744      Some(if neg { -cents } else { cents })
 2745  }
 2746  pub fn percent(part: i64, total: i64) -> String {
 2747      if total <= 0 {
 2748          return "0%".to_string();
 2749      }
 2750      let p = part as f64 / total as f64 * 100.0;

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 56 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2751      format!("{p:.1}%")
 2752  }
 2753  fn group_thousands(n: u64) -> String {
 2754      let s = n.to_string();
 2755      let bytes = s.as_bytes();
 2756      let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + s.len() / 3);
 2757      for (i, &b) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
 2758          if i > 0 && (bytes.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
 2759              out.push(',');
 2760          }
 2761          out.push(b as char);
 2762      }
 2763      out
 2764  }
 2765  fn trim_zero(v: f64) -> String {
 2766      let s = format!("{v:.2}");
 2767      s.trim_end_matches('0').trim_end_matches('.').to_string()
 2768  }

 2849  pub fn income_total(txns: &[Txn]) -> i64 {

 2864          income_cents: income_total(txns),

 2867  pub fn totals_in_range(txns: &[Txn], start: i64, end: i64) -> Totals {
 2868      totals(&filter_range(txns, start, end))
 2869  }
 2870  fn filter_range(txns: &[Txn], start: i64, end: i64) -> Vec<Txn> {
 2871      txns.iter()
 2872          .filter(|t| t.occurred_at >= start && t.occurred_at < end)
 2873          .copied()
 2874          .collect()
 2875  }
 2876  pub fn expense_month_over_month(this_start: i64, this_end: i64, prev_start: i64, prev_end: i64, txns: &[Txn]) -> (i64, i64) {
 2877      (
 2878          expense_total(&filter_range(txns, this_start, this_end)),
 2879          expense_total(&filter_range(txns, prev_start, prev_end)),
 2880      )
 2881  }
 2882  pub fn matches_query(name: &str, note: &str, amount_cents: i64, query: &str) -> bool {
 2883      let q = query.trim();
 2884      if q.is_empty() {
 2885          return true;
 2886      }
 2887      let name_l = name.to_lowercase();
 2888      let note_l = note.to_lowercase();
 2889      let plain = crate::money::to_plain(amount_cents.abs());
 2890      let grouped = crate::money::format_cents(amount_cents.abs(), false);
 2891      for token in q.split_whitespace() {
 2892          let t = token.to_lowercase();
 2893          if t.is_empty() {
 2894              continue;
 2895          }
 2896          let mut hit = name_l.contains(&t) || note_l.contains(&t);
 2897          if !hit && is_numeric_token(&t) {
 2898              hit = plain.contains(&t) || grouped.contains(&t);
 2899          }
 2900          if !hit {

【滴水记账 V9.0 源程序】                                    第 59 页
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2901              return false;
 2902          }
 2903      }
 2904      true
 2905  }
 2906  fn is_numeric_token(t: &str) -> bool {
 2907      !t.is_empty() && t.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '.' || c == ',')
 2908  }
 2909  pub fn search_indices(
 2910      names: &[String],
 2911      notes: &[String],
 2912      amounts: &[i64],
 2913      query: &str,
 2914  ) -> Vec<usize> {
 2915      names
 2916          .iter()
 2917          .enumerate()
 2918          .filter(|(i, n)| {
 2919              matches_query(
 2920                  n,
 2921                  notes.get(*i).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(""),
 2922                  amounts.get(*i).copied().unwrap_or(0),
 2923                  query,
 2924              )
 2925          })
 2926          .map(|(i, _)| i)
 2927          .collect()
 2928  }
